title: OneUptime Kubernetes agent
description: Configuration values of the OneUptime Kubernetes agent add-on. Every field is optional: the add-on sends to OneUptime Cloud with the ingestion key in the Secret oneuptime-ingestion-key, and reports the cluster under its Amazon EKS name.

oneuptime.description: The OneUptime the agent sends to, and the Secret with its ingestion key.

url.description: Your OneUptime's address: https://oneuptime.com for OneUptime Cloud, or the URL of your own OneUptime.

existingSecretName.description: Name of the Secret in the oneuptime-agent namespace that holds your OneUptime ingestion key under api-key. Create it with: kubectl create secret generic oneuptime-ingestion-key --namespace oneuptime-agent --from-literal=api-key=<ingestion key>

labels.description: Labels of your OneUptime project to put on everything this cluster sends, as key and value pairs, such as {"team": "payments"}.

preset.description: standard for clusters with EC2 nodes. eks-fargate for a cluster that runs only on Fargate: pod logs are read through the Kubernetes API instead, and the eBPF and node pods, which Fargate cannot run, are left out.

enabled.description: Send the stdout and stderr of every pod.

ebpf.description: Application traces and request metrics with eBPF, from every pod, with no code changes.

enabled.description: Run the eBPF instrumentation on every EC2 node. It loads eBPF programs into the kernel, so it runs as a privileged pod.

aiAgent.description: The Kubernetes AI agent, which runs read-only kubectl for OneUptime AI while it investigates an incident or alert on this cluster.

enabled.description: Run the Kubernetes AI agent. It can read the cluster's resources and pod logs, never Secrets, and changes nothing.

kubeStateMetrics.description: kube-state-metrics, for the monitors that need the state of pods: CrashLoopBackOff, image pull errors, pending and stuck pods.

enabled.description: Run kube-state-metrics in the add-on's namespace.

cost.description: Spend per namespace, workload and pod, priced with OpenCost.

enabled.description: Run OpenCost and the small Prometheus it needs, and send their cost allocations to OneUptime.
